methodologyNotes: The roster covers 11 current and recent high-search bread machines sold in the US market; the Panasonic SD-YR2540 was excluded because it is a 220 V/non-US model with no published USD MSRP. Primary sources are official brand stores (store.zojirushi.com, cuisinart.com, hamiltonbeach.com) and manufacturer/retailer pages; prices were cross-checked against major retailers (Walmart, Best Buy, Amazon) and price-history sites (camelcamelcamel). Booleans (true/false) indicate whether a feature is present; crust_settings is the integer count of selectable browning/crust-button levels; delay_timer_hr is the maximum hours; loaf_shape is "horizontal" for traditional rectangular pans and "vertical" for tall/upright pans. Adversarial re-verification on 2026-06-19 corrected two errors: Breville BBM800XL loaf_shape (the Custom Loaf uses a horizontal traditional pan with a single collapsible paddle, not a vertical pan) and Zojirushi BB-CEC20 gluten_free_setting (the Home Bakery Supreme has no dedicated gluten-free program). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Zojirushi Home Bakery Virtuoso Plus BB-PDC20
products.provenance: Price of $454.99 confirmed on Zojirushi Online Store (store.zojirushi.com/products/bbpdc). 15 menu settings confirmed verbatim on the official product page (White, Whole Wheat, European, Multigrain, Gluten Free, Salt Free, Sugar Free, Vegan, Rapid White, Rapid Whole Wheat, Dough, Sourdough Starter, Cake, Jam, Homemade), including a dedicated Gluten Free course. Crust control light/medium/dark = 3. Loaf shape confirmed horizontal: 'Bakes a large traditional rectangular shaped 2-lb. loaf.' 13-hour delay timer confirmed. No automatic fruit/nut dispenser. Release year per Zojirushi 2018 launch.

products.name: Zojirushi Home Bakery Mini Breadmaker BB-HAC10
products.provenance: Price $294.99 confirmed on Zojirushi Online Store. 8 menu settings confirmed on official page (basic bread regular/firm, soft, French, dough, cookie/pasta dough, cake, jam, quick bread). 1 lb capacity and 13-hour delay timer confirmed. No gluten-free program. Tall/narrow vertical pan. Crust-color count kept at 2 (regular/light family); the Regular/Firm/Soft options are dough-texture, not crust-color, settings. No automatic fruit/nut dispenser. Release year not published by Zojirushi -> blank.

products.name: Zojirushi Home Bakery Supreme Breadmaker BB-CEC20
products.provenance: Price $369.99 confirmed on Zojirushi Online Store ('Regular price $369.99 USD'). Menu settings on official page: white, wheat, sour dough starter, dough, jam, cake, quick bread + 3 Home Made memory settings = 10 distinct courses. Horizontal rectangular loaf confirmed ('Bakes a large traditional rectangular shaped 2-lb. loaf'). CORRECTED gluten free setting true->false: the official product page lists NO dedicated gluten-free program for the BB-CEC20 (gluten-free can only be improvised via recipes; the dedicated GF course is a BB-PDC20 feature). No automatic fruit/nut dispenser. Crust light/medium/dark = 3. 13-hour delay timer. Release year approximated 2010 from Amazon listing history.

products.name: Hamilton Beach HomeBaker 2-Pound Bread Maker 29882
products.priceNote: Discontinued on HamiltonBeach.com; no current MSRP; last seen ~$50-70 at retail
products.provenance: Hamilton Beach product page confirms 12 cycles + gluten free and 2 lb capacity. 12 programs (basic, French, gluten-free, whole grain, quick bread, sweet, 1.5-lb express, 2-lb express, dough, jam, cake, bake), tall rectangular/vertical pan, 3 crust settings (light/medium/dark), dedicated gluten-free mode, and 13-hour delay timer confirmed by breadmachinepros review. No automatic fruit/nut dispenser (audible add-in reminder only). the price blank because model is discontinued with no current MSRP. Release year not published -> blank.

products.name: Oster Expressbake 2-Pound Breadmaker CKSTBRTW20
products.priceNote: Discontinued; last known retail ~$60; currently unavailable new from major retailers
products.provenance: 12 programs confirmed by breadmakerguides review (Basic, French, Whole Wheat, Sweet, Express Bake 1.5lb, Express Bake 2lb, Quick, European, Dough, Bagel Dough, Jam, Bake). Vertical pan confirmed ('almost square, vertical loaf shape'). 4 crust-button settings (light/medium/dark/rapid) confirmed by breadmakerguides ('Crust color button: light, medium, dark or rapid') -> retained as 4. No dedicated gluten-free cycle and no automatic fruit/nut dispenser confirmed. 13-hour delay timer (not usable with ExpressBake). Discontinued; last known ~$60 retail -> the price blank. Release ~2009 per manual.

products.name: Zojirushi Home Bakery Maestro Breadmaker BB-SSC10
products.priceNote: MSRP, Zojirushi Online Store ("Regular price $429.99 USD")
products.provenance: Model identity confirmed as the exact BB-SSC10: both the Zojirushi Online Store and Zojirushi.com pages are titled "Home Bakery Maestro Breadmaker BB-SSC10" with "Model No. BB-SSC10", and the breadmakerguides review is of the same model. Price $429.99 confirmed verbatim on store.zojirushi.com/products/bbssc ("Regular price $429.99 USD"). 1-lb. loaf capacity, 15 course selections (Amazon spec table also lists "Number of Programs 15"), dedicated Gluten Free course, Auto Add fruit/nut dispenser, and 13-hour delay timer are all stated verbatim on the Zojirushi pages; crust settings=2 derives from "Crust Control for a medium or dark crust" (an Amazon owner review confirms this machine's crust settings are only "medium and dark", unlike 3-level machines). loaf shape="vertical" from the breadmakerguides review calling it a "small, but tall, one pound loaf bread machine" with height (13-5/8 in) as its largest dimension, consistent with the sibling 1-lb BB-HAC10. No release year is published on any fetched page, so release is left blank.

products.name: West Bend Hi-Rise Bread Maker 47413
products.priceNote: MSRP $129.99 on the official West Bend store (westbend.com), SKU 47413 ("Regular price $129.99").
products.provenance: Model identity confirmed on the official West Bend store page (SKU 47413) and the West Bend Amazon Store listing (Model Number 47413, UPC 072244474138, Manufacture Year 2013) — this is the current 3-lb Hi-Rise, not the discontinued 41410/41300 siblings. Price $129.99 taken verbatim from West Bend's official store ("Regular price $129.99"); the Amazon page returned EUR figures due to geolocation and was not used for price. Both pages confirm 12 digital settings (Basic, Wheat, French, Sweet, Dough, Gluten-Free, Custom), a traditionally shaped horizontal bread pan with dual knead blades and 3 loaf sizes (2/2.5/3 lb, max 3 lb), 3 crust levels (Light/Medium/Dark), a dedicated Gluten-Free program, and a delay-start cycle up to 13 hours; the West Bend Hi-Rise line has no automatic fruit/nut dispenser (manual add-in alert, per breadmakerguides), and release year 2013 is per Amazon's "Manufacture Year 2013" field.

products.name: Elite Gourmet Programmable Bread Maker EBM8103B
products.priceNote: MSRP $74.99 on the official Elite Gourmet store (shopelitegourmet.com), listed for the EBM8103B Black. Amazon US listing showed only a localized EUR price (EUR 65.63 for German delivery), so USD price taken from the manufacturer store.
products.provenance: The Elite Gourmet store page (shopelitegourmet.com) lists this exact model "EBM8103B" at MSRP $74.99 and confirms up to a 2-lb loaf (3 sizes: 1/1.5/2 lb), a 19-programmed preset menu, crust color light/medium/dark (=3), a gluten-free capable program, and a "15-HOUR DELAY TIMER." The Amazon listing (ASIN B08BSP4GL1) independently verifies model identity — "Model Number EBM8103B," Part Number EBM8103B, Manufacturer Maximatic, "Manufacture Year 2021" — and repeats "Number of Programs 19," "Capacity 2 Pounds," light/medium/dark crust, gluten-free presets, and a 15-hour delay timer. loaf shape left blank (neither page states horizontal/vertical verbatim); fruit nut dispenser=false since only a manual "add your favorite nuts" note appears with no automatic dispenser; the price $74.99 comes from the US manufacturer store because Amazon displayed only a EUR price for German delivery.

products.name: Dash Everyday 1.5 LB Bread Maker DBM150
products.priceNote: Regular price $99.99 on the official Dash store (bydash.com/products/everyday-1-5-lb-bread-maker).
products.provenance: Official Dash store page (bydash.com, SKU DBM150GBAQ01, Aqua) confirms Regular price $99.99, "Twelve pre-programmed baking modes"/"12 unique presets," a dedicated Gluten-Free preset, an "automatic dispenser for fruits, nuts, and fillings" (Ingredient Drop), crust color "light, medium, and dark settings" (3), a "13-hour delay timer," and "1-1.5lb loaf capacity." The Amazon listing (ASIN B08NMZBNN4) corroborates the exact model — Model Number DBM150GBBK01 is the Black variant of the same DBM150 Everyday 1.5 LB Bread Maker, with "Number of Programs 12" and "Capacity 1.5 Pounds" — confirming this is the exact model and not a sibling or different-capacity unit (Amazon showed no purchasable price). loaf shape (horizontal/vertical) and release year are not stated verbatim on either page, so both are left blank.
